heading: Extraction gate
explainer: Controls what Cogeto extracts facts from, per source kind. A blocked source is still stored; only its extraction is refused, and every refusal is listed below rather than silently dropped.

connectors.heading: Source kinds
connectors.explainer: Untouched rows keep the defaults: extraction on, the built-in budget, facts kept until something supersedes them.

rules.heading: File format rules
rules.explainer: Allow or block extraction by detected file format. The format comes from the file's bytes, never its name. "Allow" rules make the list exclusive: only the allowed formats extract.

refusals.heading: Recently refused
refusals.explainer: Sources the gate refused to extract from. The source itself is kept; change the settings above and reprocess it to extract after all.

refusalReason.extraction_disabled: extraction is off for this source kind
refusalReason.source_disabled: this source was switched off individually
refusalReason.document_class_denied: its file format is blocked by a rule
